answer: Proof-of-bond: each agent must bridge scarce onyx into a smart contract and show an ivory attestation signed by a distinct verified human before it can act. If one identity is caught signing two conflicting ledgers, the contract slashes its entire onyx bond. A Sybil attacker thus needs a fresh onyx stake and a unique ivory guarantor per fake agent, so every extra identity costs real locked capital, not a free generated key.
